{{Quote|A lot can happen in twenty-five thousand years, Master Skywalker.|[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TSW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''25,000 BBY'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|Twenty-five thousand years of records. It's like&mdash;like I'll be part of the history of the whole galaxy!''"<br />"''You would be, regardless.''"<br />"''Oh, yeah, sure, I know: everybody is. But not everybody's in the Jedi Archives, are they? I mean, my name'll be there ''forever''. It's like being immortal&hellip;|[[Nick Rostu]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
*The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] is founded, linking [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] is mapped, ensuring the economic dominance of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the forming [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]; the Corellian Run forms the southern border of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*With the development of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt|Rana]] allows for a wave of colonization to embark from [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]; one of the colony [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] is the planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]],<ref name="Atlas" /> which is colonized by a group of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] led by [[Chla C'cHaan]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Sanbra Duros">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref>
*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sar Agorn]] takes on a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Cope Shykrill]], but Shykrill falls to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and is struck down. {{Circa}}<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*The last year that the [[Alzoc system/Legends|Alzoc system]] was part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="Atlas" />
